## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (or at least `npm test`)
- [ ] No new crates and no npm packages
- [ ] User-facing texts exist in German and English
- [ ] New or changed levels pass `stapelwerk check-levels --strict --mutate`
- [ ] Docs updated if the machine, the ABI or the level format changed (`docs/`)
- [ ] No private paths or e-mail addresses in the diff
